title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract: Number of Plans a Customer May Hold
content:
**Rule.** A customer may hold Kestrel Care plans on any number of vehicles, subject to one plan per vehicle.

The Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract sets no maximum number of plans per customer. The only limit on how many plans one customer holds is the vehicle: each vehicle carries one plan.

| Question | Answer under the rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a cap on the number of Kestrel Care plans one customer may hold? | No. There is no maximum per customer. |
| What does limit a customer's plans? | One plan per vehicle. |
| May a customer with plans on several vehicles hold one more plan on a further vehicle? | The number of plans already held is no bar; the further vehicle is subject to one plan per vehicle. |

### Hypothetical illustration

A customer holds a Kestrel Care Gold plan on one household vehicle and a Kestrel Care Platinum plan on a second. The count of plans already held places no limit on a plan for a third vehicle; each of the three vehicles carries its own single plan.
